About the Position
The Telecommunications Technical Officer plays a critical role at Online Star PTY LTD in supporting the delivery of NBN fibre and telecommunications network projects. This position involves field-based technical support, testing coordination, quality oversight and technical guidance across active project sites. The role sits between the Project Engineers and the field technicians and is essential to ensuring that network works are delivered to the required technical standards, that faults are diagnosed and rectified efficiently, and that completed works meet client acceptance requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Reviewing job packs, network plans, asset records and scopes of work before field work begins and confirming the design intent against site conditions.
Attending project sites to assess ground conditions, identify service and access risks, and confirm the scoped works can be built to the client design and NBN requirements.
Providing technical direction to field technicians during fibre hauling, splicing, pit and pipe works, exchange patching and BNTD installation.
Coordinating and verifying fibre testing using OTDR and optical power meters, and validating results against applicable NBN and client acceptance requirements before handover to the delivery partner.
Diagnosing fibre, duct, patching and connection faults on site, tracing the cause and setting out the rectification steps required to keep the job on schedule.
Checking completed works against the plans, job packs and NBN specifications, and confirming they are ready for submission to the project manager or delivery partner.
Preparing and updating as-built records, test results, site reports, defect notes and completion packs.
Coordinating with project engineers, supervisors, delivery partners, subcontractors and customers on site access, progress, technical issues and completion sign-off.
Monitoring crews on site to confirm they follow the approved work method, the SWMS and the relevant technical standards.
Escalating complex design, structural or safety matters to the Project Engineers or management where higher-level approval is required.
Reviewing rejected or non-compliant work, identifying why it failed, and instructing field crews on the correct method to bring it back to standard.
Keeping records of materials, equipment, test outcomes, network locations and work status to support project tracking and partner reporting.
Monitoring the performance of completed fibre network segments, interpreting transmission and optical test results, and identifying where network performance requires correction or improvement.

## Telecommunications Technical Officer / Technologist
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Telecommunications Technical Officer or Technologist to join our team and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance telecommunications infrastructure. This role is responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and optimisation of complex communication networks and systems across a range of technologies. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on technical experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This position suits a proactive professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of network performance and service delivery.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain microwave, satellite, telemetry, and other radio and electromagnetic communication systems, ensuring all equipment operates to specification and within regulatory requirements.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve network faults, performance issues, and equipment malfunctions in a timely and effective manner, minimising disruption to services.
- Integrate telecommunications networks with computer hardware, software platforms, operating systems, databases, and peripheral devices to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
- Monitor the ongoing performance of complex networks and communication systems, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for optimisation before they impact service quality.
- Plan and support the development of customer access network infrastructure, contributing to capacity planning, design reviews, and upgrade programmes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation including inventory logs, equipment records, asset statuses, and communication policies, procedures, and quality standards in accordance with organisational and regulatory guidelines.
- Provide clear technical advice and support to internal stakeholders, project teams, and end users on telecommunications systems, configurations, and best practices.
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and external service providers to coordinate procurement, installation activities, and ongoing service delivery, whilst monitoring contractual performance and obligations.
- Support the design and optimisation of network architecture, contributing technical input to projects aimed at improving reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment testing to ensure network integrity and compliance with applicable standards.
- Assist in the development and review of technical documentation, including network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and incident reports.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on telecommunications projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from scoping through to commissioning and handover.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A diploma, advanced diploma, or bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
- Demonstrated experience in a telecommunications technical role, with hands-on exposure to radio frequency (RF), microwave, satellite, or fixed-line communication systems.
- Solid understanding of network protocols, telecommunications standards, and systems integration principles.
- Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network hardware, software, and associated technologies including switches, routers, and transmission equipment.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and fault management systems, with the ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.
- Strong documentation skills with the ability to maintain accurate records, produce technical reports, and adhere to quality and compliance standards.
- Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work methodically under pressure, and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes.
- A valid Australian driver's licence, as field-based work and site visits may be required.
- Willingness to participate in an on-call roster or undertake out-of-hours work when operational requirements demand.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent telecommunications qualifications.
- Experience working with microwave backhaul systems, fibre optic networks, or mobile network infrastructure (2G/3G/4G/5G).
- Familiarity with Australian telecommunications regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements, including those governed by the ACMA.
- Exposure to project management methodologies and experience contributing to telecommunications infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed services or enterprise network environment.
- Postgraduate qualifications in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and highly skilled engineering team working on critical telecommunications infrastructure that makes a real difference to communities and businesses across Australia.
- Enjoy genuine opportunities for professional development, including access to industry training, certifications, and career progression pathways within the organisation.
- Benefit from a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, with options for hybrid arrangements where operational requirements allow.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation contributions, and access to additional employee benefits including wellness programmes and paid leave entitlements.
- Work on a diverse range of projects and technologies that will broaden your technical expertise and keep you at the forefront of the evolving telecommunications landscape.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Database Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the design, implementation, and ongoing management of our database systems. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the integrity, security, and performance of organisational data assets. This role suits a proactive and technically proficient professional with a strong background in database management and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality data infrastructure. Experience working within a collaborative IT environment and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders will be highly regarded.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain database architecture, data structures, tables, and naming conventions to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of all data master files
- Establish, monitor, and maintain backup and recovery procedures, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption in the event of a system failure
- Implement and enforce database security protocols, integrity controls, and access management policies to safeguard sensitive organisational data
- Administer and maintain comprehensive database documentation, including guidelines, policies, and operational procedures, ensuring these remain current and fit for purpose
- Plan and perform database upgrades, patches, and migrations, including thorough testing, debugging, and issue resolution in accordance with approved quality assurance processes
- Monitor database performance on an ongoing basis, identifying bottlenecks and implementing tuning, indexing, and optimisation strategies to maximise efficiency
- Collaborate with developers, systems analysts, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into effective and scalable database solutions
- Analyse existing database systems and workflows, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance reliability, performance, and maintainability
- Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance for database-related incidents, working to resolve issues promptly and minimise operational impact
- Ensure database environments comply with relevant data governance frameworks, privacy legislation, and organisational standards, including alignment with Australian Privacy Principles where applicable
- Assist in capacity planning activities by assessing current usage trends and forecasting future storage and performance requirements
- Support the development and maintenance of data integration processes, including ETL pipelines and data warehouse environments, in collaboration with cross-functional teams
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a Database Administrator or similar role, with hands-on responsibility for managing enterprise-level database environments
- Proficiency in one or more leading relational database management systems, such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
- Strong working knowledge of SQL, including query writing, stored procedures, functions, and performance tuning
- Experience designing and implementing backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies in production environments
- Solid understanding of database security principles, including user access controls, encryption, and audit logging
- Ability to diagnose and resolve complex database performance issues through monitoring tools, execution plans, and indexing strategies
- Familiarity with data modelling techniques and the ability to translate business requirements into well-structured database designs
- Sound understanding of IT service management practices and experience working within structured change management processes
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with both technical teams and business stakeholders
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant vendor certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional, or equivalent
- Experience with cloud-based database platforms, including Azure SQL, Amazon RDS, or Google Cloud SQL
- Exposure to NoSQL database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis
- Experience in data warehousing environments and familiarity with ETL tools and processes
- Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation of routine database tasks
- Familiarity with DevOps practices and experience working within Agile or ITIL-aligned environments
- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as finance, healthcare, or government, with an understanding of associated compliance obligations
